# secobserve_user (List Resource)

Lists every SecObserve user. Terraform stops after 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Emits import blocks and configuration for every user.
list "secobserve_user" "all" {
  provider = secobserve
}
```
